regions.full_page: Simon Goulah - 45 - Fractured skull. Wife & 3 small children August 25, 1932 - To-day Mr. Goulah came to monastery with whole family. Is well except for a lame back received from an "orderly" in Rec. Hospital. - Got kick April 18 just before leaving ... laxetive .... Jan. 23, 1934 Mrs. Goulah in To-day ... Husband O.K. - working every day.
